# #2045: Patch: the card-picks upload and the dev fill and clear take the account's economy lock, so two writes at once can't lose one
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When two devices touch the same account's card cosmetics at the same time — say a phone uploads its saved picks while the desktop picks a new finish on that card — one device's choices can silently overwrite the other's. The same holds for the developer tools that fill or empty a test account's collection: a pack opened at the same moment can lose cards the opening just granted. After this patch all of those writes queue behind each other the way the rest of the economy's writes already do, so no change is silently lost.

## Why

`put_card_pick` takes `economy_lock_account` before its read-modify-write — its comment says why: "two devices' writes take turns, so neither's change is lost" (`crates/server/src/api/card_picks.rs:98-128`). But `upload_card_picks` (`card_picks.rs:206-215`), which merges a device's stored picks, takes no lock: an upload row committing between a PUT's `economy_card_picks_get` and its unconditional `economy_card_picks_put` is overwritten wholesale. The dev `fill` (`crates/server/src/api/dev.rs:192-211`) and `clear`/`clear_cards` (`dev.rs:280-291, 401-424`) likewise read quantities then write absolute upserts with no lock, while `give_xp` (`dev.rs:131`) and `fill_bar` (`dev.rs:318`) lock deliberately. The advisory lock exists and is re-entrant (`economy/store.rs:1467-1475`).

## Proposal

Call `tx.economy_lock_account(&profile.id)` at the top of `upload_card_picks`, dev `fill` and dev `clear`, inside their existing transactions. The in-memory fake serializes transaction bodies so the race is only observable on Postgres; a contract test can still assert the lock is taken (the store logs it) or record the reasoning in a comment, as `rewards.rs:291` does.

## Where it lands

`crates/server/src/api/card_picks.rs`, `crates/server/src/api/dev.rs`, `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `upload_card_picks` holds the account's economy lock across its read-merge-write
- [ ] dev `fill` and dev `clear` hold it across theirs
- [ ] No change to request or response shapes, or to what the fake answers
- [ ] Each lock site says why, as `put_card_pick`'s comment does

## Size and risks

Small: three one-line additions plus a contract assertion or comment. The only cost is a longer critical section on dev endpoints, which are low-traffic and dev-gated by design.
